about_the_company:
! 

 Raptor was founded in 2002 with the mission to protect every child, every school, every day. Today, Raptor is a school safety partner for 60,000 schools in 55 countries, providing SaaS and mobile technology as well as comprehensive training and consultation solutions across the entire school safety life cycle, ranging from crisis prevention and preparation to emergency response and recovery. Raptor’s globally integrated product portfolio supports a school’s foundation of safety and wellbeing, including Emergency Management, Campus Movement, Student Wellbeing and Safety Training and Compliance.
position_overview:
The social media manager will plan, schedule, and create social media copy and graphics to promote content, products, and thought leadership while growing our community of followers. 

 This is a 3 month temporary, part time position (20 hours/week) starting in June . Preference will be given to candidates located in Eastern or Central time zones.
key_responsibilities:
Manage the company’s social media profiles and presence, including LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube. 

 Regularly develop and post content to all social platforms. 

 Use Canva to create thoughtful and shareable content appropriate for specific networks to both spread our brand and our content and links. 

 Pull and edit clips from webinar recordings to repurpose into video content. 

 Ensure a thought leadership approach is taken when creating copy that represents our brand and builds engagement through meaningful conversations. 

 Review community engagement activity and respond professionally when appropriate. 

 Work alongside other marketers and content producers to share awareness of upcoming events and funding deadlines. 

 Explore new ways to engage and new social networks to reach our target buyers, including building our user groups.
qualifications:
Proficiency in Pardot, HootSuite, Sendible, and other social posting/monitoring tools. 

 Familiarity with Monday.com for project management. 

 High attention to detail and an ability to select the key information to share from lengthy content. 

 Experience with current B2B social media marketing trends and strategies. 

 Ability to produce polished first-draft social copy for review. 

 Bonus experience and skills include Adobe Creative Suite, demand generation. marketing, inbound marketing, and blogging.
